Definition: something to fume (incense) on i.e. a hearth place
BiblicalUsage: The word is the altar of incense, the hearth place for burning, and it appears once, when God commands Moses to make an altar of shittim wood for burning incense before the veil.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the incense altar is the prayer of the people made visible: the smoke rose morning and evening, and so must prayer.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
